title: Order I Rule 10 CPC — Add or strike parties

content.overview: The court may strike a wrong party and add a necessary or proper party so the controversy can be decided completely.
content.study: Necessary party: no effective decree without them. Proper party: useful but not fatal if missing. Limitation against a newly added defendant is a separate fight.
